verdict.rationale: Event-driven rule automation is a fair axis for a payroll/HR SaaS, but the evidence pack has no user-definable rule or trigger-action feature in Paychex Flex. The webhooks listed in the API docs are a developer building block for constructing such automation, not the capability itself. Built-in automatic tax handling, Intelligent Pay Cycle flags, and compliance alerts are fixed vendor behaviors, not rules a user defines.
